actions.scope: Chrome Local State within this newly created ephemeral user-data-dir only

scope: Environment-only observer: one directly spawned Chrome with an explicitly owned temporary user-data-dir, its default context attached through public connectOverCDP({noDefaults:true}), exactly two owned tabs and a tiny localhost HTML page. No game, emitted runtime, worker, source simulation, or acceptance gate is exercised.
limitations: Only native debug UI enablement is changed; public noDefaults:true avoids installing Playwright focus emulation. No Emulation commands are sent. No synthetic visibility/wasDiscarded override, crash, discard-all action, reload fallback, extension or user-browser connection is used.
Native hidden visibility, exact-owned urgent discard UI state, new document identity and document.wasDiscarded=true are mandatory. Any failure remains a failed observation.
Source checks bind this observer and related setup/report helpers plus HEAD and source-freeze bytes. This no-game observer does not recompute or qualify the complete runtime.
